name: prontera-vendors
author: BlaXun
description: Themed player vendors on Prontera's sidewalks: cards, weapons, armor, potions, dungeon loot and more, each stall drawing a random subset of its theme at real-market prices. Stalls come and go like real players, so the market keeps changing. Needs the population engine switched on.

settings.label: Vendors
settings.description: How many stalls stand on Prontera's sidewalks. With fewer stalls than themes, a different set of themes shows up each time the server starts. 0 removes them all.

settings.label: Minutes before a stall changes
settings.description: How long a vendor stays before packing up and another takes the spot, give or take a little so they don't all change at once. 0 keeps them until the server restarts.

settings.label: Vendors shout their wares
settings.description: Stalls call out an item and its price now and then, like "S> Elunium 250K".

settings.label: Seconds between a stall's shouts
settings.description: On average, per stall; each waits between half and one and a half times this. Stalls also never shout within a few seconds of one another.
